context.description: The run header shows the spec title

evidence.trustReason: Given/When and whole-run header, metadata styling, subtree title, empty-title fallback, status fields, and older-header isolation are asserted through command input and TUI rendering; 4 focused tests pass. Gap in the Left out step: the test computes expected ids with TaskCommand.leftOut(plan), the same production function used by TaskCommand.header. It only checks nonempty and absence of S3. A wrong list such as one omitted id instead of all omitted ids passes both the message and metadata assertions. Assert the expected omitted scenario ids independently from the loaded fixture. The test also stops at a recording Ops boundary rather than stored SessionPrompt parts, so forwarding remains untested here.
